extracts.intro: PLACEHOLDER — You hear two colleagues discussing a training course.

1.stem: PLACEHOLDER — What does the woman say about the course materials?
options: They were harder to follow than she had expected.
They repeated content she already knew well.
They were poorly matched to the length of the course.

2.stem: PLACEHOLDER — The two speakers agree that the tutor
options: gave too little time to individual questions.
explained the practical tasks unusually clearly.
relied too heavily on his own experience.

extracts.intro: PLACEHOLDER — You hear a musician talking about a recent tour.

3.stem: PLACEHOLDER — How did she feel about the opening night?
options: Relieved that a technical problem went unnoticed.
Surprised by the reaction of the audience.
Frustrated by the size of the venue.

4.stem: PLACEHOLDER — What does she say she would do differently next time?
options: Involve the band in planning the set list.
Spend less time rehearsing in advance.

extracts.intro: PLACEHOLDER — You hear part of a radio programme about urban wildlife.

5.stem: PLACEHOLDER — The speaker suggests that public attitudes to city foxes
options: have shifted more slowly than researchers predicted.
are shaped mainly by inaccurate media coverage.

6.stem: PLACEHOLDER — What does the speaker recommend that residents do?
options: Report sightings to a national database.
Change how they store household waste.
Avoid feeding animals during the winter.
